text:
harper_pm: Quick kickoff 0 min thread. We need 3 design partners for a short, tightly-scoped Private + Dedicated pilot. Focus: routing resilience (fallbacks), KMS integration, and a lightweight feedback loop that surfaces quality regressions. Shortlist by Mon, invites Tue.

devin_se: I'll build a tiny quickstart that exercises routing, KMS key use, and emit a small trace. ETA Thu. Will include a one-command local deploy and a sample test suite.

mira_ops: Ops note: some customers won't accept peering, so we need to support VPN + hosted-edge. I can do two peering setups; third likely VPN. I'll draft a concise infra checklist (one page).

own_research: Proposed product acceptance criteria (short):
- Perf: p95 within agreed threshold for the canonical prompt set
- Resilience: fallback success (fallback completes or clean rollback) >= 99%
- Onboard: <72 dev-hours to reach baseline traffic for >=1 route
- Quality: nightly auto-eval pass rate >= 90% for extraction tasks
- Feedback: partner responds to 2 scheduled check-ins during pilot
These are what we'll include in outreach.

tess_sales: Incentive idea: $5k credit + 8 weeks priority Dedicated + 3 office-hour sessions with eng. Also offer a short PR blurb if they want. Is that compelling?

harper_pm: Good. Add a short MOU that asks for 608 weeks active engagement and a product contact. We'll attach NDA link. legal-bot: DP NDA v2026-04-01 available -> https://redwood.docs/nda-dp.

devin_se: Screening q's draft:```
1) Avg QPS and average token length?
2) KMS provider and can you provide a test key?
3) Which network option works for you (peering/VPN/hosted-edge)?
4) Any compliance constraints (HIPAA, PCI, SOC2)?
5) Who is the internal approver for go/no-go?
6) Please provide one representative prompt + expected output sample.
```
Add suggestions.

own_research: Add: "Do you consent to nightly automated evals against a canned dataset?" and "Can you emit token-level cost telemetry or provide equivalent logs?"

mira_ops: Onboarding checklist (short): IP allowlist, VPN creds or peering details, KMS test key, on-call contact, and a signed MOU. I'll post the template.

devin_se: Sample curl we'll include in quickstart to trigger routing and fallback logging:```
curl -s -X POST https://private.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DP_KEY' \
  -H 'x-dp-trace: dp-test' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-routing-lite","prompt":"force fallback","timeout_ms":900}'
```
This will record the chosen path and any fallback events.

tess_sales: Outreach flow: short email -> 30m tech discovery -> sign NDA/MOU -> onboarding checklist -> week2 health check -> week6 wrap. I'll draft the email and a spreadsheet with owners.

harper_pm: Owners: @tess_sales outreach, @devin_se quickstart + SDK, @mira_ops infra + runbook, @own_research metrics + prompts, @harper_pm program lead. Target shortlist Mon EOD and invites Tue AM.

own_research: Prompt set: I'll author 10 canonical prompts spanning convo, extraction, and short-code. Will produce automated eval runner that can run against partner-provided dataset or our canned set.

devin_se: I'll include a tiny observability shim that posts p50/p95 and fallback counts to our console and a CSV export for partners. ETA Fri.

mira_ops: Rollback playbook idea: automatic split to hosted (80/20) if p95 > threshold for 10m, escalate and move to full rollback after 30m if health doesn't recover. Will document knobs.

harper_pm: Success to graduate pilot: at least 2 partners meet perf + resilience SLOs, integration effort under 72h, and partner engagement (responds to check-ins). If not met, extend pilot + fix SDK/infra.

tess_sales: I'll prioritize one mid-size PLG and one enterprise with regulatory needs. Need one more warm lead; will pull from channel sales.

legal-bot: Reminder: use the "Beta - Design Partner" NDA variant in invites. Link above.

harper_pm: Great work. Keep the thread lean. Please update the spreadsheet row when you take an action so we can track owners. We'll reconvene in Tue sync if shortlist is ready.
